head: Something has to change for the Jets
paras: The Jets are winless in seven (0-5-2). The Panthers have won two in a row. The Cats won the first meeting this season, 5-1 in Winnipeg. Going in, the Jets are seventh in the Central and the Panthers fifth in the Atlantic.

Both teams rarely ice the puck. The Jets create chances on the penalty kill, but take a lot of low-percentage shots. They’re second in shorthanded threat. The Panthers hound the puck on the forecheck and hit a lot, and they’re first in the league in both.

Kyle Connor leads the Jets with ten goals and 14 points. For the Panthers, it’s Matthew Tkachuk, with 20 points, four of them goals, and he has nine points over the last five. Brady Tkachuk leads them in goals with eight.
Stuart Skinner should get the start for Winnipeg (3-3-3, .899 in nine starts), and Akira Schmid for Florida (4-2-1, .884 in six starts).
The Panthers’ power play has a soft target in the Jets’ kill.

items.text: The Panthers have been without Jacob Markström, Aleksander Barkov and Brad Marchand for several games. Akira Schmid is expected to start.
The Jets have been without Josh Morrissey since Oct 7.
Brady Tkachuk has a point in five straight games against Winnipeg.
Mark Scheifele has five goals in seven games against Florida since 2023-24.

FLA.head: The Panthers should have the upper hand
FLA.body: Even though Florida will be without Barkov, the Panthers have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and have home-ice advantage. On top of that, Winnipeg is on the second night of a back-to-back and will be without Morrissey. The Jets’ way back in is keeping dangerous shots away.

WPG.head: Not an easy night for the Jets
WPG.body: Even though Florida will be without Barkov, the Panthers have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and have home-ice advantage. On top of that, Winnipeg is on the second night of a back-to-back and will be without Morrissey. The Jets’ best way through is keeping dangerous shots away.

calls.head: The Panthers come in rested
calls.body: It’s the Jets’ second game in two nights. Teams on the back end of those usually spend more time defending, so we think the Panthers get more of the play than usual.

calls.head: The Panthers’ power play has a target
calls.body: The Panthers’ power play is near the top of the league, and the Jets’ kill is near the bottom. Every trip to the box hurts the Jets more than most.
